pages.title: Obby: Supercar Race on Keyboard
pages.creator: Serbull
pages.description: Drive over giant keys in Obby: Supercar Race on Keyboard. Train to increase speed, collect cars, and complete obstacle tracks to earn wins and open new zones. Pets, vehicle upgrades, and rebirth bonuses offer further progression.

pages.title: Tower Smash: Can Blaster
pages.creator: CrowdPlayStudio
pages.description: Knock structures off their platforms in Tower Smash: Can Blaster. Aim the cannon at stacks of cans and blocks, then fire within the shot limit. Look for weak spots that can bring down several objects with one hit.

pages.title: Everything is in place: Rare finds
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Tidy cluttered spaces in Everything is in place: Rare finds. Drag objects into their proper positions and bring order to each location. Examine the arrangement to work out where every item belongs.

pages.title: Fox Adventure
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Keep a fox running through hazards in Fox Adventure. Jump over spikes and avoid falling meteors while collecting coins. Spend the coins in the shop on costumes such as the Cyber-Fox or royal outfit, then try to survive longer.

pages.title: 2048 Merge World
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Combine equal-numbered blocks in 2048 Merge World. Each merge doubles their value, taking you from small numbers toward 2048 and beyond. Manage the available board space so a crowded field does not stop your progress.

pages.title: No Pain No Gain - Ragdoll Sandbox
pages.creator: Rike Games
pages.description: Set up damaging contraptions in No Pain No Gain - Ragdoll Sandbox. Drag traps into place and send the ragdoll into them. Each hit earns coins, making the arrangement of your hazards central to the experiment.

pages.title: Cozy Kitchen Merge
pages.creator: XMetaGame
pages.description: Combine matching food in Cozy Kitchen Merge. Drag identical ingredients and dishes together to create the next item and build your score. Work through food-themed goals, from bowls of porridge to larger pancake creations, in the kitchen's physics-based play area.

pages.title: Word Seasons
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Make words from the available letters in Word Seasons. Find answers that fit the empty spaces above the board and continue through the puzzles. Use a hint when needed while the seasonal backgrounds change with your progress.

pages.title: Math Runner
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Choose answers while running in Math Runner. Solve arithmetic questions quickly and take the path with the correct result, since a wrong answer ends the run. Avoid obstacles and collect coins and power-ups while chasing a higher score.

pages.title: Basketball Life 3d
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Take on basketball shooting tasks in Basketball Life 3d. Work through hoop challenges and trick shots, using each attempt to judge your timing. Complete the shot required by a level before moving to its next basketball challenge.

pages.title: Room Sort
pages.creator: dotplay gmbh
pages.description: Rearrange sections of a house in Room Sort. Swap room-shaped blocks to complete the floor plan and align the door connections. Check how neighboring rooms fit together as you organize the entire layout.

pages.title: Queen of Mahjong
pages.creator: NovaSky
pages.description: Remove matching objects in Queen of Mahjong. Find identical tiles that can be connected by a route of at most three straight segments. Work through different themed worlds as you clear the available pairs.

pages.title: Emerland Solitaire
pages.creator: Rainbow Games
pages.description: Travel through a magical land in Emerland Solitaire. Complete card puzzles and combinations while helping a knight, an elven archer, and a sorceress oppose the Dark Master. Earn rewards and discover assistants as the journey continues.

pages.title: Super Kid Adventure
pages.creator: kidsgamesplay
pages.description: Jump through twenty-five platform levels in Super Kid Adventure. Avoid spikes and other obstacles, defeat enemies, and collect stars on the way. Use the arrow keys or on-screen movement buttons to guide the character through each stage.

pages.title: Tile Guru Match Fun
pages.creator: Clever Apps Pte. Ltd.
pages.description: Clear groups of three identical open tiles in Tile Guru Match Fun. Select matching designs until the entire board is empty. Hints and power-ups can help when you cannot find the next combination.

pages.title: Mahjong Royal
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Match exposed pairs in Mahjong Royal. Clear the layout or locate its special tiles while dealing with reversed pieces and trapped tiles. Matching scissors frees trapped pieces, and seasons or flowers can pair even when their pictures differ.

pages.title: Blackpink Formal Dance Party
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Style Jennie, Lisa, Jisoo, and Rose for senior night in Blackpink Formal Dance Party. Choose dresses and combine them with hairstyles and makeup. Create a separate formal look for each member before the celebration.

pages.title: Sudoku 4 in 1
pages.creator: Filgame
pages.description: Fill a nine-by-nine grid in Sudoku 4 in 1. Place digits from one to nine so none repeats within a row, column, or three-by-three box. Drag numbers into empty cells and check their relationships before committing to an answer.

pages.title: Rainbow Monster Impostor Catcher
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Chase impostors in Rainbow Monster Impostor Catcher. Move through the map and jump to capture the characters you are pursuing. Use WASD and the space bar, or the on-screen buttons, to control the monster's hunt.

pages.title: Bicycle Stunt 3D
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Jump and slide past obstacles in Bicycle Stunt 3D. Watch the road from behind the rider and trigger each action as a hazard approaches. Use W or the up arrow to jump and S or the down arrow to duck.

pages.title: Bff Stylish Off Shoulder Outfits
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Help friends choose their next looks in Bff Stylish Off Shoulder Outfits. Explore the shopping and clothing options with the off-shoulder style in mind. Put together an outfit for each friend using the available pieces.

pages.title: Obby Blox Parkour
pages.creator: Poly Games
pages.description: Cross an obstacle course in Obby Blox Parkour. Move around the platforms, turn the camera, and time your jumps to make the next landing. Use WASD and the space bar on a keyboard or the game's touch controls.

pages.title: Stack Ball
pages.creator: tinyDream
pages.description: Break through revolving platforms in Stack Ball. Click and hold to drive the bouncing ball downward through the helix structure. Time your inputs as the stack rotates and work toward the end of the tower.

pages.title: Cook and Match: Sara's Adventure
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Collect cooking ingredients in Cook and Match: Sara's Adventure. Swap neighboring icons to line up three or more, keeping Sara's shopping list in mind. Bigger matches create helpers such as knives and blenders, and each level brings a different collection goal.

pages.title: Escape from Blue Monster
pages.creator: Berezka
pages.description: Gather food while fleeing a pursuer in Escape from Blue Monster. Avoid balls that slow you down, and buy bombs to clear nearby obstacles or stun the monster. A temporary rage knife lets you cut through hazards during its effect.

pages.title: Grand Vegas Simulator
pages.creator: GameBiz
pages.description: Carry out police driving assignments in Grand Vegas Simulator. Pass checkpoints without hitting cones, escort the president, attend accidents, and stop fleeing cars. Finish missions to earn ranks and unlock additional vehicles.

pages.title: Sausage Run
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Beat the other runners in Sausage Run. Hold the control to make the red sausage move faster and try to take first place. Watch the rivals as you push your runner toward a win.

pages.title: Veggie Slice Frenzy
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Slice vegetables by dragging across them in Veggie Slice Frenzy. Cut several in combinations to multiply your points and fill the meter for Frenzy mode. Take on the boss vegetable while trying to raise your score.

pages.title: Mine Shooter Monsters Royale
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Fight as a lone block-world survivor in Mine Shooter Monsters Royale. Aim your gun at attacking zombies and Huggy Wuggy enemies before they overwhelm you. Move, reload, change stance, and throw grenades as the battle requires.

pages.title: Top Guns IO
pages.creator: MOBASO
pages.description: Fight to be the final survivor in Top Guns IO. Use your weapon against opponents in a confined battle area and stay alive through the exchanges. Keep moving as you work toward being the last combatant remaining.

pages.title: Stick Duel: Revenge
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Battle with armed stick figures in Stick Duel: Revenge. Use flying shoes, advanced weapons, and the level's layout while avoiding fire pools and traps. Challenge the computer or a second player, with the first to five points winning the match.

pages.title: Royal Offense 2
pages.creator: Elite Games Ltd
pages.description: Expand your kingdom through combat in Royal Offense 2. Train heroes and improve troops and spells before facing enemy forces. Manage your army in real time as you try to defeat the opposition.

pages.title: Screw the Nut
pages.creator: Garbuz Studio
pages.description: Bring a nut to its bolt in Screw the Nut. Click blocks to remove them and let gravity set the nut rolling. Work out which supports to erase across twenty-two physics puzzles.

pages.title: Geometry
pages.creator: Absolutist Ltd.
pages.description: Time your taps on moving shapes in Geometry. Wait until a symbol matching your selected shape reaches the center, then tap to score. Clock bonuses slow the movement, while hearts help you continue after mistakes.

pages.title: Draw & Save Him
pages.creator: OneTwoPlay
pages.description: Draw lines to help the character survive in Draw & Save Him. Study the traps in each level and sketch a line that keeps him clear of the danger. Work through locations ranging from desert scenes to the city.

pages.title: Golf Club
pages.creator: magnificstudios
pages.description: Sink the ball in one shot in Golf Club. Judge the route to the hole and set up a precise attempt. Work through thirty levels, adjusting your shot for each new layout.

pages.title: Blocky Chains
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Turn the entire board blue in Blocky Chains. Connect at least three adjacent matching candies horizontally, vertically, or diagonally to change the spaces beneath them. Cover every block to finish each of twenty-four levels.

pages.title: Pin Water Rescue
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Direct water toward a burning house in Pin Water Rescue. Pull pins to open the correct route through the cave. Plan the flow carefully, because releasing the water in the wrong direction can drown the trapped character.

pages.title: Dice Push
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Build a larger pushing team in Dice Push. Roll the dice to send stick figures toward the green wall and force it across to your opponent's side. Aim throws at enemy figures to reduce their numbers.

pages.title: Spot The Differences
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Compare paired pictures in Spot The Differences. Tap details that differ between the two images and work within the available time. Complete twenty challenges by finding the changes in each scene.

pages.title: Element Evolution
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Develop a growing farm in Element Evolution. Merge resources and plants to unlock new varieties, then use the income to acquire more land. Expand the farm to support further crops and resource production.

pages.title: Lucky Golden Piggies
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Build a collection of piggy banks in Lucky Golden Piggies. Tap to fill the grid, then merge two identical pigs into a new one. Collect the coins they generate, buy more pigs, and work toward the golden piggy.

pages.title: The Frog Prince Jigsaw
pages.creator: Playschoolgames
pages.description: Reassemble scenes from a fairy tale in The Frog Prince Jigsaw. Choose an illustration and the difficulty you want to tackle. Move the pieces into place to complete pictures inspired by the Frog Prince story.

pages.title: Princesses Rock Ballerinas
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Blend ballet fashion with rock styling in Princesses Rock Ballerinas. Choose clothing and accessories that bring the two influences into one outfit. Experiment with the princesses' looks to combine stage elegance with a heavier style.

pages.title: Day In Aquarium Hidden Stars
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Search underwater scenes in Day In Aquarium Hidden Stars. Locate ten concealed stars in each of six pictures before the timer ends. Repeated incorrect clicks remove five seconds, so check details before making a guess.

pages.title: Bike Stunt Race Master 3d Racing
pages.creator: ideagames
pages.description: Ride through motorcycle trials in Bike Stunt Race Master 3d Racing. Use the arrow keys to control your bike and complete the track's tasks. Progress from easier riding sections to courses that demand more technical handling.

pages.title: Grab Party.io
pages.creator: crazyschoolgames
pages.description: Throw rivals out of the ring in Grab Party.io. Pick a character, approach other contestants, and grab them to send them beyond the arena. Stay inside the boundary until you are the last competitor remaining.

pages.title: Big Must Jump
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Keep two moving squares apart in Big Must Jump. Tap the correct side to make the larger square leap over the smaller one. Judge their positions quickly, because the small square cannot clear the big one.

pages.title: Make your own Princess
pages.creator: MyCuteGames
pages.description: Create a royal character in Make your own Princess. Choose from the available appearance and clothing options to give her a personal style. Follow the dress-up prompts as you assemble your own princess design.

pages.title: Tank Strategy Game
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Plan your force before combat in Tank Strategy Game. Buy tanks and fuel at the start of each level, then position the vehicles for the attack. Choose a deployment that lets your army confront the enemy effectively.

pages.title: Stickman Race 3D
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Compete for first place in Stickman Race 3D. Guide your runner against the opponents and finish first in all three rounds to win the level. Use mouse or touch controls to take part in the race.

pages.title: 2048 Automatic Strategy
pages.creator: PixelMaskGames
pages.description: Let the board move itself in 2048 Automatic Strategy. When automatic merging gets stuck, make a move with the arrow keys or a swipe to restart progress. Build your score to earn more moves and extend the run.

pages.title: Turbo Stars
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Skate past rivals in Turbo Stars. Steer through the course at speed, perform stunts, and avoid obstacles that end the attempt. Use mouse or swipe controls to chase better scores and beat more competitors.

pages.title: Orbiting Xmas Balls
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Shoot at a rotating cluster of festive bubbles in Orbiting Xmas Balls. Reach the target score to complete a level. Extra points above that target help with later stages, making accurate shots useful beyond the current board.

pages.title: Airplane Fly Simulator
pages.creator: Best Free Games
pages.description: Pilot a commercial jet in Airplane Fly Simulator. Take off, guide the aircraft through the waypoints, and reach the correct destination to deliver passengers on time. Control turns and throttle before bringing the plane in to land.

pages.title: Learning Kids Memory
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Pair classroom-themed pictures in Learning Kids Memory. Turn over cards and remember their positions to find identical images. Clear all the pairs before the level's timer expires.

pages.title: Grave Drive
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Drive over side-view terrain in Grave Drive. Reach each finish line quickly while gathering gold coins along the route. Complete eight levels spread across two locations using arrow keys or touch controls.

pages.title: Cubes Blast
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Trim a moving square to fit past obstructions in Cubes Blast. Click away the necessary cubes from its three-by-three shape as it travels along the conveyor. Leave the other cubes in place and reshape it for each upcoming barrier.

pages.title: BTS Boat Coloring
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Decorate a selected boat picture in BTS Boat Coloring. Apply the colors you prefer, then print the completed artwork. You can also print the original outline and color it by hand.

pages.title: Medieval Vikings Jigsaw
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Assemble twelve seafaring pictures in Medieval Vikings Jigsaw. Pick an image and choose a 25-, 49-, or 100-piece layout. Move its parts into place to restore the complete Viking scene.

pages.title: Shoe Designer
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Create your own footwear in Shoe Designer. Work with styles such as pumps, sandals, and stilettos and choose their design details. Use the mouse to put together a pair with the appearance you want.

pages.title: Dots Mania
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Join colored dots in Dots Mania. Form connections and squares while playing with a timer, a move limit, or endless rules. Earn cups from high scores and use them for bonuses such as removing colors or adding time.

pages.title: Do Not Touch The Border
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Guide a small ball through a narrow route in Do Not Touch The Border. Keep it away from the edges as you move. A careful path through the available space is needed to avoid touching the boundary.

pages.title: Monster Mahjong
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Clear creature-themed tiles in Monster Mahjong. Find matching designs and remove them before the timer runs out. Use the available power-ups when the remaining arrangement makes the next pair difficult to find.

pages.title: While We Sleep Slendrina Is Here
pages.creator: danygames.com
pages.description: Search a park for six keys in While We Sleep Slendrina Is Here. Face Slendrina and her helpers while moving through the area with your weapons ready. Collect the keys and fight the enemies standing in your way.

pages.title: Paper Racer
pages.creator: Nikitos.com
pages.description: Race over hand-drawn tracks in Paper Racer. Choose from six vehicles and tackle courses with devices such as teleports and changing gravity. Try campaign stages and player-created tracks, or draw and share a course of your own.

pages.title: Coloring Farm Pets
pages.creator: Age Simple Games
pages.description: Color pictures of farm animals in Coloring Farm Pets. Select a scene and choose the shades you want to apply. Work through the animal details to give the picture your own color scheme.

pages.title: Homecoming Princess Aurora
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Help Aurora get ready for her party in Homecoming Princess Aurora. Follow the steps to make a homemade shaving cream, then use it during her grooming routine. Complete the preparation before the homecoming celebration.

pages.title: Squashy Bug
pages.creator: Red Eye Production
pages.description: Gather food from beneath passing people in Squashy Bug. Move between their feet to reach the next item without being stepped on. Wait for room to pass rather than rushing into the path of a shoe.

pages.title: Jigsaw Puzzle Autumn
pages.creator: Physical Form
pages.description: Put together sixteen seasonal scenes in Jigsaw Puzzle Autumn. Fit the scattered pieces into complete pictures of fall. Use the colors and outlines within each image to find where the remaining pieces belong.

pages.title: Color Spin
pages.creator: VGSTudios
pages.description: Launch balls toward a central core in Color Spin. Time shots through moving obstacles to collect the points required for the next level. Collisions end the attempt, and the music provides the time limit for each challenge.

pages.title: Smash the Blocks
pages.creator: Red Eye Production
pages.description: Break brick walls with bouncing balls in Smash the Blocks. Aim for a path that strikes as many blocks as possible before the balls return. Clear more of the formation to build a higher score.

pages.title: Free Words
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Make words from a limited selection of letters in Free Words. Type valid combinations before the timer runs out. Rearrange the same letters mentally to find additional answers and increase your total.

pages.title: Bubbles Shooter
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Clear the bubble field in Bubbles Shooter. Aim shots to gather matching colors and remove groups from the arrangement. Plan each launch around the bubbles that remain until the board is empty.
